name: same_training_strata_gradient_diagnostic
question: At the two completed 500-update checkpoints, are the gradients from the main weak group and signed negative groups aligned or opposed, and which parameter groups carry that relation?
training_cases: Lexicographically first NOISY TRAIN case per condition and geometry; eight conditions times six geometries = 48 cases. No selection by errors, no validation cases.
outputs: per-case scalar loss and gradient norms
template projection and color error on those same training probes
execution_condition: Run only after the fixed negative_balanced500 job has exited and both endpoint receipts are complete.
interpretation_limit: A training-gradient relation is a local diagnostic, not proof of a unique cause or independent validation. This diagnostic does not authorize new training or changed gates.
